01 / YOUR VILLAGE

Bring your village.

Your export becomes your upgrade plan.

Where do I get the JSON? +
  1. Open Clash of Clans.
  2. Go to Settings → More Settings.
  3. Scroll to Export village data in JSON format and tap Copy.
  4. Paste the entire export below.

Use the in-game export for buildings and timers. A public API player profile only provides a partial plan.

{ }PASTE OR DROP A .JSON FILE

Paste a complete village JSON object or use Upload JSON.
